facts.business: Sundrop Brands Limited (formerly Agro Tech Foods Limited) is an Indian FMCG company engaged in the manufacturing and marketing of food products including edible oils, spreads, ready-to-eat foods, and snacks under brands such as Sundrop, Act II, and Del Monte, operating through its wholly-owned subsidiaries in India, Bangladesh, and Sri Lanka.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company aims to pursue a strong growth trajectory following the acquisition of Del Monte Foods Private Limited, including investments in capacity expansion, brand development, product innovation, and selective strategic acquisitions.

auditor.name: B S R and Co, Chartered Accountants

key_risks: Investment risk in employee benefit plans
Interest rate risk affecting defined benefit obligations
Salary risk due to inflationary pressures
Customs duty dispute pending before Supreme Court
Pending legal cases relating to disputes over title to shares
facts.related_party_note: The Company has a defined benefit provident fund managed by its own Trust, a superannuation fund administered by its own Trust with ICICI Prudential Life Insurance, and a gratuity plan funded through its own Trust with ICICI Prudential Life Insurance. Loans to employees and pledged deposits with government authorities are disclosed.
